steps.title: Draw the trunk
steps.instruction: Begin at the bottom left of the trunk, near the sand, and draw a long line curving up and slightly right to the crown, stopping just under the middle of the canvas. Then draw the matching right edge from the base up to the same point, letting the two lines bow apart at the bottom so the trunk is widest where it meets the ground.

steps.title: Add the trunk rings
steps.instruction: Draw the short bands across the trunk, starting near the base and working upward. Each band runs from the left edge to the right edge and slants slightly, and the spaces between them get smaller as you go up toward the coconuts.

steps.title: Start the fronds going left
steps.instruction: From the top of the trunk, draw a long line sweeping down and out to the left for the lowest left frond, then draw the second long frond just above it. Both start at the same crown point and spread apart as they travel outward.

steps.title: Add the right fronds
steps.instruction: Draw two long lines from the crown sweeping down and out to the right, the upper one reaching farther than the lower one. Keep the start of each line close to the trunk so the fronds all meet at one spot.

steps.title: Fill in the middle fronds
steps.instruction: Add the shorter fronds that rise and arch between the ones you have. Draw the tall one going up toward the middle of the crown first, then the fronds that fall to either side of it, so the crown looks full.

steps.title: Draw the left leaflet pairs
steps.instruction: Along the left fronds, draw the short leaflet strokes that come off the main line in pairs. Start near the crown and work toward the tips, keeping each stroke about the width of a finger and slanting toward the frond tip.

steps.title: Draw the right leaflet pairs
steps.instruction: Do the same for the right fronds, adding short paired strokes along each main line from the crown to the tip. Match the spacing and slant you used on the left side so both sides look alike.

steps.title: Draw the coconuts
steps.instruction: At the top of the trunk, just below where the fronds meet, draw the round coconut shapes as overlapping ovals. Begin with the lowest coconut hanging in front, then add the ones above and to the sides, letting each new oval sit slightly behind the one before it.

steps.title: Draw the sand and grass
steps.instruction: Draw the long flat line of the sand edge running left to right beneath the trunk, then add the shorter lines that shape the sand patch in front. Finish with the small grass tufts at the base of the trunk and the short pebble marks on the sand.

steps.title: Colour the fronds dark green
steps.instruction: Fill the whole crown of fronds with dark green, working from the crown out to the tips. Keep the colour inside the leaflet strokes so the feathery edges stay crisp.

steps.title: Colour the fronds green
steps.instruction: Fill the remaining frond area with the lighter green, covering the parts of the crown not already coloured. Leave no white gaps between the leaflets.

steps.title: Colour the sand
steps.instruction: Fill the sand patch under the tree with a sand colour, bringing it up to the base of the trunk and out to the wide flat edge on the left.

steps.title: Colour the coconuts
steps.instruction: Fill the coconut cluster with the warm brown, keeping each oval separate so the overlaps stay visible.

steps.title: Colour the trunk
steps.instruction: Fill the trunk with the orange-brown, covering the whole curve from the sand to the coconuts. Leave the ring lines showing as dark bands.

steps.title: Add the pale frond highlights
steps.instruction: Fill the pale grey-green shapes that sit along the upper edge of the fronds and the highlight on the coconuts, so the crown catches the light.

steps.title: Colour the grass and pebbles
steps.instruction: Fill the small grass tufts at the base of the trunk and the pebble marks on the sand with the muted tan colour.
